scripts.build:worker: pnpm build:dependencies && pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .open-next/dry-run
scripts.cf-typegen: rm -rf .open-next && wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts
scripts.cf-typegen:check: rm -rf .open-next && wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false --check cloudflare-env.generated.d.ts
scripts.deploy:hosted: pnpm build:dependencies && pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.preview: pnpm build:dependencies && pnpm preflight:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
